summary: The Furry 3D Block Puzzle inspired on Sudoku. Test your IQ & Logic Skills.
description: If you merge Block Games with Sudoku and add a little of fur, you get Furzies, a line block puzzle game with loads of challenges. With a fluffy vibe and several furzies to collect, you will get a challenging block-doku to test your mental acuity and IQ. This is a great logic game to test your skills. Test your IQ and train your brain with our little monsters and furry monsters. Your most important and biggest goal is to get the highest score. Block Puzzle Game Furzies is an easy to play and learn block puzzle game, but you'll want to play as long as you can to beat your own score. This is a fun, simple, free block puzzle game that you can play on your break or anytime you want to have fun or improve your concentration! ✔9x9 block doku board. Join the furzies blocks on the grid. If you like Sudoku, you will probably love this game ✔ You can make simple line combinations horizontally, vertically or in boxes ✔ Players can combine similar furzies to improve them ✔ Players can tap on the furzies to get their effect. Each monster has a different effect ✔ The goal is to clear the grid ✔ Multiple furzies effects can result in multipliers in the score Join us for these charming merge and block doku games. Is a super fun, cute, minimalistic, addictive and classic block puzzle game designed to entertain you as much as possible. Have fun with this new title from Infinity Games, an expert in minimal and relaxing gameplay! Do you like our work?
